// diagnostic

E0088

Source holds the invisible bidirectional control `{character}`

What

Source holds the invisible bidirectional control `{character}`

Why

A bidirectional control reorders how the text around it displays, so the code a reviewer reads can differ from the code Jet compiles.

Fix

Delete the character; data that must carry it builds the text from its bytes with `\x` escapes in a `[U8]` literal.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0088: tests/ui/bidi_control_in_source.stderr.

Error [jet.BidiControlInSource]: Source holds the invisible bidirectional control `U+202E`
